source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.official_english: Countries move gold out of the United States
topics.why_hot: Online users are tracking reports that several countries have shipped gold out of U.S. storage, reviving discussion about national reserves and global finance.
topics.share_angle: Explain how and why central banks store gold overseas, and what repatriation might signal about trust in financial systems.

topics.official_english: GPT-6 draws attention over high cost
topics.why_hot: The link between GPT-6 and the idea of being expensive is fueling conversation about the affordability and real-world accessibility of next-generation AI.
topics.share_angle: Break down why frontier AI models could be costly to train and deploy, and what that means for users and businesses.

topics.chinese_topic: 安徽大学回应副校长涉武大举报事件
topics.official_english: Anhui University responds after vice president linked to Wuhan University complaint
topics.why_hot: A university’s response to a controversy involving a senior administrator has put institutional accountability and academic integrity under public discussion.
topics.share_angle: Avoid unverified details and instead explain how universities usually respond to internal integrity cases and whistle-blowing complaints.

topics.chinese_topic: 被要求补缴社保 老板店门口滚屏抱怨
topics.official_english: Shop owner uses scrolling storefront sign to complain over social insurance payment order
topics.why_hot: A visible protest by a small employer over being asked to make up social insurance payments has touched off debate on business costs and labor protections.
topics.share_angle: Use the story to explain how China’s social insurance system works, including employer contributions and why small businesses may feel squeezed.

topics.chinese_topic: 在中国第一个春节 他被烟花吓了一跳
topics.official_english: Visitor startled by fireworks during first Spring Festival in China
topics.why_hot: A newcomer’s surprise at festive fireworks is being shared as a lighthearted example of how Spring Festival traditions feel to first-time visitors.
topics.share_angle: Introduce Spring Festival customs through a fresh perspective, including the cultural meaning of fireworks and modern rules around their use.

topics.chinese_topic: 尼泊尔不向中国寻求气候正义赔偿
topics.official_english: Nepal does not seek climate justice compensation from China
topics.why_hot: The statement has sparked online discussion about climate liability, global climate finance, and how developing countries seek support.
topics.share_angle: Clarify what climate justice compensation means and outline the broader debate over loss and damage in international climate talks.

topics.chinese_topic: 王楚钦退出WTT澳门冠军赛
topics.official_english: Wang Chuqin withdraws from WTT Champions Macao
topics.why_hot: Table tennis fans are reacting to the star player’s withdrawal and wondering what it may mean for the tournament lineup.
topics.share_angle: Explain the demands of the international table tennis calendar and why top athletes sometimes withdraw to manage workload and injury risk.

topics.chinese_topic: 莆田站点降雨量全国第一
topics.official_english: Putian station logs highest rainfall nationwide
topics.why_hot: Extreme rainfall logged at a Putian station has moved it to the top of the national rainfall rankings, putting local weather under public attention.
topics.share_angle: Use the rainfall record to explain how precipitation is measured and why localized extreme rain events matter for preparedness.
